statement: For the finite conic formulation frozen in problem.md, let alpha be the unique root in (-1/24,-1/25) of 32 alpha^3+48 alpha^2+26 alpha+1=0. Its exact optimum is v_*=-(32 alpha^2+16 alpha+1)/36, the root near -0.0108411477500751 of 576 v^3-16 v^2+92 v+1=0. The complete exposed optimal face in (x,X,p) is the singleton specified exactly in evidence/exact_solution.md; it is fixed by reverse-complement. The same file gives matching exact primal and dual certificates, with exact PSD, nonnegativity, complementary-slackness, and uniqueness verification reproduced by evidence/exact_certificate.py.
contribution: This resolves all three parts of the frozen question: it closes the source's feasible-versus-numerical gap with an exact algebraic optimum, supplies matching conic certificates, and classifies the full face including the auxiliary representing probability vector. The source itself provides only the weaker -1/100 feasible value and an uncertified numerical value near -0.0108; no priority claim beyond the bounded comparison recorded in problem.md is made.
